notes: Watched on Qwen Code 0.28.4 (its default Ink renderer, `en` locale) in tmux at 120x40, against a scripted OpenAI-compatible server on loopback: a shell call, a write it asked to apply, a slow turn stopped with Esc, Esc twice at an empty prompt, and every approval mode's idle footer; the sign-in screens on a home with no provider. Ink draws the UI under the scrollback, not at the pane's foot, so the rows below it are blank, which `bottom:N` skips. The window title is a constant `Qwen - <folder>` and is not a signal. A `How is Qwen doing this session? (optional)` survey can sit above the prompt between turns; it takes a typed digit but not a pasted message. Not yet watched: the OpenTUI renderer (opt-in, with Bun), an ask_user_question dialog, a shell or MCP approval (a plain `echo` ran without asking under `default`), and a turn past a minute.

any: (?i)you must connect a provider to proceed
rules.note: A home with no provider opens on the `Connect a Provider` dialog, and the subscription's sign-in shows the `chat.qwen.ai/authorize?user_code=…` link over `Waiting for sign-in…` (both watched, 0.28.4); Ctrl+C there prints the third line (en locale).

any: (?m)^\s*(Apply this change\?|Do you want to proceed\?|Allow execution of)
rules.note: The tool confirmation: `Apply this change?` over `1. Yes, allow once`, `2. Yes, allow always`, `3. No, suggest changes (esc)`, with `Waiting for user confirmation...` where the timer was and no input box (a write_file, watched on 0.28.4). The shell's `Allow execution of: '<command>'?` and `Do you want to proceed?` are the en locale's, not yet watched. Anchored to the start of the line, so a reply quoting them does not count.
ask_user_question's dialog ends on `Submit answers` and asks `Ready to submit your answers?` (en locale, 0.28.4). Read, not watched.

Esc twice at an empty prompt (two Stops at an idle session) opens `Rewind Conversation (<n> turns)` over the whole pane, with `↑↓ to navigate · Enter to select · Esc to cancel` (watched, 0.28.4): Qwen waits on a choice there, and an Enter typed into it picks a turn to rewind to.

The loading line, a random phrase then the timer, `.. Polishing the pixels... (6s · esc to cancel)` (with `· ↑ <n> tokens` once some arrive), anchored to the timer that ends it, and the footer `Enter to steer · Ctrl+Q to queue · <mode>` a turn shows under the input box (both watched, 0.28.4). The sign-in dialog's `Esc to cancel` has no timer, and a reply quoting the words mid-line does not end on them.

The footer under the input box names the approval mode, `⏸ Ask permissions`, `Auto mode`, `auto-accept edits` or `YOLO mode`, each `(shift + tab to cycle)`, whatever the prompt holds; one Esc swaps it for `Press Esc again to rewind conversation.` (watched, 0.28.4) or `… to clear.` (en locale). Mid-turn the same footer leads with `Enter to steer`, which the guards keep working; the placeholder `Type your message or @path/to/file` is no signal, since it stays during a turn and goes when the prompt holds text.
